name: attr/model/tier
description: Restricts AI agents based on the cost and reasoning capability of the underlying model.

name: attr/data/clearance
description: Standard data classification levels for controlling agent access to sensitive TDFs.

name: attr/capability/filesystem
description: Broad operational bundles for agent filesystem access. 'navigate' allows ls/cd; 'read_content' allows cat/grep.

name: attr/capability/network
description: Network permissions for agents. Agents can hold multiple specific network rights.

name: attr/tools/specific
description: Granular allowlist for specific shell or CLI commands. Used for high-security, limited-scope agents.

name: attr/agent/identity
description: Defines the operating mode of the agent (attended vs unattended).
